input_eligibility.rna_only_query_condition: Reconsider only if the exact historical Poisson-MultiVI artifact is recovered and an RNA-only query posterior can project held liver donors without ATAC or held-donor fitting. This path must pass the project's fixed no-ATAC profile fixture before selection lock.

interpretation: The NeurIPS weight predates GSE289173 and is target-label-unexposed with high confidence. It still cannot compete in the current held-back or RNA-conditioned ATAC tracks: weight terms are undeclared, the checkpoint-specific context encoder is absent, published context uses observed ATAC, and held-donor/cross-tissue induction is unvalidated.

noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.johahi_neurips_scooby_rna: A separate MIT-tagged RNA-only checkpoint exists, but it has two RNA output tracks and is not the registered NeurIPS multiome object. It cannot silently replace this checkpoint or supply an ATAC output.
noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.retrained_project_latent: Training a new MultiVI/Poisson-MultiVI model on project data creates a new coordinate system. It requires a fitted bridge or decoder adaptation and must be registered as a new adaptation rather than called frozen NeurIPS inference.
